title: Upādānam
text: 2 Upādāniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi upādānañ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || 3 Katame ca bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā katamañ ca upādānaṃ || || 4-9 Cakkhum bhikkhave upādāniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ || pa || || Jivhā upādāniyo dhammo || la || || Mano upādāniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ || || 10 Ime vuccanti bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā idam upādānanti || ||
